<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" class="scroll-smooth">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>GhostMC SMP — Official Ranks & Store</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com/3.4.17"></script>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/qrcodejs/1.0.0/qrcode.min.js"></script>
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Creepster&family=Nosifer&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=Orbitron:wght@600;700;800;900&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <style>
        :root,
        body[data-theme="horror"] {
            --bg-base: #030102;
            --bg-surface: rgba(20, 4, 7, 0.88);
            --bg-card: rgba(26, 5, 9, 0.88);
            --accent-primary: #dc2626;
            --accent-secondary: #991b1b;
            --accent-tertiary: #f97316;
            --glow-rgba: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.52);
            --glow-secondary: rgba(153, 27, 27, 0.38);
            --grid-line: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.08);
        }
        body[data-theme="phantom"] {
            --bg-base: #05030f;
            --bg-surface: rgba(15, 10, 34, 0.78);
            --bg-card: rgba(19, 13, 42, 0.82);
            --accent-primary: #a855f7;
            --accent-secondary: #ec4899;
            --accent-tertiary: #f59e0b;
            --glow-rgba: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.42);
            --glow-secondary: rgba(236, 72, 153, 0.28);
            --grid-line: rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.07);
        }
        body[data-theme="nether"] {
            --bg-base: #0d0404;
            --bg-surface: rgba(31, 10, 10, 0.80);
            --bg-card: rgba(38, 12, 12, 0.84);
            --accent-primary: #f97316;
            --accent-secondary: #ef4444;
            --accent-tertiary: #eab308;
            --glow-rgba: rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.42);
            --glow-secondary: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.30);
            --grid-line: rgba(249, 115, 22, 0.07);
        }
        body[data-theme="emerald"] {
            --bg-base: #020c07;
            --bg-surface: rgba(6, 28, 18, 0.80);
            --bg-card: rgba(8, 35, 22, 0.84);
            --accent-primary: #10b981;
            --accent-secondary: #06b6d4;
            --accent-tertiary: #a3e635;
            --glow-rgba: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.42);
            --glow-secondary: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.28);
            --grid-line: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.07);
        }
        body[data-theme="frost"] {
            --bg-base: #040914;
            --bg-surface: rgba(10, 20, 40, 0.80);
            --bg-card: rgba(13, 25, 48, 0.84);
            --accent-primary: #22d3ee;
            --accent-secondary: #3b82f6;
            --accent-tertiary: #818cf8;
            --glow-rgba: rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.42);
            --glow-secondary: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.30);
            --grid-line: rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.07);
        }
        body {
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
            background-color: var(--bg-base);
            color: #f1f5f9;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            transition: background-color 0.4s ease;
        }
        .font-display {
            font-family: 'Orbitron', sans-serif;
        }
        .bg-grid-pattern {
            background-image:
                radial-gradient(circle at 15% 15%, var(--glow-rgba) 0%, transparent 38%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 85% 25%, var(--glow-secondary) 0%, transparent 40%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 50% 85%, var(--glow-rgba) 0%, transparent 45%),
                linear-gradient(to right, var(--grid-line) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--grid-line) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 100% 100%, 100% 100%, 100% 100%, 36px 36px, 36px 36px;
            background-attachment: fixed;
        }
        .neon-glow {
            box-shadow: 0 10px 40px -10px var(--glow-rgba), 0 0 25px var(--glow-secondary), inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
        }
        .neon-text {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffffff 0%, var(--accent-primary) 45%, var(--accent-secondary) 80%, var(--accent-tertiary) 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            filter: drop-shadow(0 0 18px var(--glow-rgba));
        }
        .theme-card-glass {
            background: var(--bg-card);
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
            box-shadow: 0 12px 32px -8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
        }
        .theme-btn-primary {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-primary), var(--accent-secondary));
            color: #ffffff !important;
            box-shadow: 0 8px 25px -4px var(--glow-rgba);
        }
        .theme-btn-primary:hover {
            filter: brightness(1.12);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }
        .card-hover {
            transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
            backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
            box-shadow: 0 14px 34px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
        }
        .card-hover:hover {
            transform: translateY(-8px) scale(1.015);
            box-shadow: 0 22px 45px -12px var(--glow-rgba), 0 0 25px var(--glow-secondary), inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28);
        }
        @keyframes floatSlow {
            0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0px) rotate(0deg); }
            50% { transform: translateY(-10px) rotate(1deg); }
        }
        .animate-float {
            animation: floatSlow 4.5s ease-in-out infinite;
        }
        @keyframes borderPulse {
            0%, 100% { border-color: var(--accent-primary); }
            50% { border-color: var(--accent-secondary); }
        }
        .theme-border-pulse {
            animation: borderPulse 4s ease-in-out infinite;
        }
        #upi-qr-container img, #upi-qr-container canvas {
            margin: 0 auto;
            border-radius: 0.75rem;
        }
        /* Custom scrollbar */
        ::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 8px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: var(--bg-base);
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: var(--accent-primary);
            border-radius: 4px;
        }

        /* Horror Theme Special Atmosphere & Blood Vignette */
        body[data-theme="horror"] {
            box-shadow: inset 0 0 130px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.95), inset 0 0 55px rgba(185, 28, 28, 0.32);
        }
        body[data-theme="horror"] .font-horror-title {
            font-family: 'Creepster', 'Orbitron', cursive;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
            animation: horrorFlicker 5s infinite alternate;
        }
        body[data-theme="horror"] .neon-text {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #fca5a5 30%, #ef4444 65%, #7f1d1d 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            filter: drop-shadow(0 0 22px rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.85)) drop-shadow(0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9));
        }
        @keyframes horrorFlicker {
            0%, 18%, 22%, 25%, 53%, 57%, 100% {
                opacity: 1;
                filter: drop-shadow(0 0 18px rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.85));
            }
            20%, 24%, 55% {
                opacity: 0.72;
                filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.3));
            }
        }
        @keyframes ghostDrift {
            0% { transform: translateY(0px) translateX(0px) scale(1); opacity: 0.16; }
            50% { transform: translateY(-18px) translateX(12px) scale(1.06); opacity: 0.32; }
            100% { transform: translateY(0px) translateX(0px) scale(1); opacity: 0.16; }
        }
        .ghost-float-entity {
            animation: ghostDrift 7s ease-in-out infinite;
        }
        body:not([data-theme="horror"]) .horror-only-decor {
            display: none !important;
        }
        /* Blood-Crimson Remapping for Horror Mode */
        body[data-theme="horror"] header,
        body[data-theme="horror"] footer,
        body[data-theme="horror"] #connect,
        body[data-theme="horror"] #staff,
        body[data-theme="horror"] #privacy-policy {
            background-color: rgba(8, 2, 4, 0.88) !important;
            border-color: rgba(185, 28, 28, 0.35) !important;
        }
        body[data-theme="horror"] .text-cyan-400,
        body[data-theme="horror"] .text-cyan-300 {
            color: #f87171 !important;
        }
        body[data-theme="horror"] .border-cyan-400\/50,
        body[data-theme="horror"] .border-cyan-500\/30,
        body[data-theme="horror"] .border-cyan-500\/40,
        body[data-theme="horror"] .border-cyan-400\/30 {
            border-color: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.55) !important;
        }
        body[data-theme="horror"] #open-cart-btn {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #dc2626, #7f1d1d) !important;
            color: #ffffff !important;
            box-shadow: 0 8px 25px -4px rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.55) !important;
        }

        /* Side Ghost Jumpscare Animations & Screen Shake */
        @keyframes screenShakeHorror {
            0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0) rotate(0deg); }
            15% { transform: translate(-10px, 6px) rotate(-1deg); }
            30% { transform: translate(10px, -8px) rotate(1.2deg); }
            45% { transform: translate(-12px, -4px) rotate(-1.2deg); }
            60% { transform: translate(9px, 7px) rotate(0.8deg); }
            75% { transform: translate(-7px, 4px) rotate(-0.6deg); }
        }
        .horror-screen-shake {
            animation: screenShakeHorror 0.55s cubic-bezier(0.36, 0.07, 0.19, 0.97) both;
        }
        #ghost-scare-overlay {
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 9999;
        }
        .ghost-lunge-left {
            animation: lungeFromLeft 1.65s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards;
        }
        .ghost-lunge-right {
            animation: lungeFromRight 1.65s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards;
        }
        @keyframes lungeFromLeft {
            0% { transform: translateX(-130%) scale(0.55) rotate(-18deg); opacity: 0; }
            18% { transform: translateX(8%) scale(1.25) rotate(8deg); opacity: 1; }
            32% { transform: translateX(2%) scale(1.38) rotate(-5deg); opacity: 1; }
            55% { transform: translateX(6%) scale(1.32) rotate(4deg); opacity: 0.96; }
            100% { transform: translateX(-140%) scale(0.7) rotate(-15deg); opacity: 0; }
        }
        @keyframes lungeFromRight {
            0% { transform: translateX(130%) scale(0.55) rotate(18deg); opacity: 0; }
            18% { transform: translateX(-8%) scale(1.25) rotate(-8deg); opacity: 1; }
            32% { transform: translateX(-2%) scale(1.38) rotate(5deg); opacity: 1; }
            55% { transform: translateX(-6%) scale(1.32) rotate(-4deg); opacity: 0.96; }
            100% { transform: translateX(140%) scale(0.7) rotate(15deg); opacity: 0; }
        }
        @keyframes bloodFlashPulse {
            0% { opacity: 0; }
            20% { opacity: 0.78; }
            45% { opacity: 0.35; }
            65% { opacity: 0.6; }
            100% { opacity: 0; }
        }
        .blood-flash-active {
            animation: bloodFlashPulse 1.5s ease-out forwards;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body data-theme="horror" class="bg-grid-pattern min-h-screen flex flex-col selection:bg-red-600 selection:text-white relative">

    <!-- Haunted Horror Atmospheric Overlay (Visible in Horror Theme) -->
    <div class="horror-only-decor fixed inset-0 pointer-events-none z-0 overflow-hidden" aria-hidden="true">
        <!-- Blood Moon Glow Top Right -->
        <div class="absolute -top-24 right-10 w-72 h-72 rounded-full bg-red-600/20 blur-3xl"></div>
        <!-- Crimson Abyss Fog Bottom -->
        <div class="absolute bottom-0 inset-x-0 h-44 bg-gradient-to-t from-red-950/35 via-black/40 to-transparent"></div>
        <!-- Floating Haunted Icons -->
        <div class="ghost-float-entity absolute top-28 left-[6%] text-3xl select-none">👻</div>
        <div class="ghost-float-entity absolute top-48 right-[8%] text-2xl select-none" style="animation-delay: 1.8s;">💀</div>
        <div class="ghost-float-entity absolute bottom-32 left-[12%] text-2xl select-none" style="animation-delay: 3.2s;">🩸</div>
        <div class="ghost-float-entity absolute bottom-48 right-[14%] text-3xl select-none" style="animation-delay: 2.4s;">🕷️</div>
    </div>


    <!-- Side Ghost Jumpscare Overlay (Pops from Left or Right Side periodically) -->
    <div id="ghost-scare-overlay" class="fixed inset-0 hidden items-center overflow-hidden" aria-hidden="true">
        <!-- Blood Flash Backdrop -->
        <div id="ghost-scare-flash" class="absolute inset-0 bg-[radial-gradient(circle_at_center,rgba(220,38,38,0.55)_0%,rgba(127,29,29,0.85)_65%,rgba(0,0,0,0.95)_100%)] opacity-0"></div>

        <!-- Scary Ghost Entity Card/Figure -->
        <div id="ghost-scare-figure" class="relative flex flex-col items-center p-4 sm:p-6">
            <div class="relative w-52 h-60 sm:w-72 sm:h-80 flex items-center justify-center filter drop-shadow-[0_0_35px_rgba(220,38,38,0.95)]">
                <!-- Custom Terrifying Haunted Wraith / Ghost SVG -->
                <svg viewBox="0 0 240 280" class="w-full h-full">
                    <defs>
                        <radialGradient id="wraithCore" cx="50%" cy="40%" r="60%">
                            <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#1f0306"/>
                            <stop offset="65%" stop-color="#090102"/>
                            <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#dc2626" stop-opacity="0.7"/>
                        </radialGradient>
                        <radialGradient id="eyeGlow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
                            <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff"/>
                            <stop offset="35%" stop-color="#ef4444"/>
                            <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#7f1d1d" stop-opacity="0"/>
                        </radialGradient>
                    </defs>
                    <!-- Tattered Shroud / Cloak -->
                    <path d="M120 12 C58 12 24 64 22 135 C20 185 10 232 6 268 L38 242 L58 272 L86 240 L120 276 L154 240 L182 272 L202 242 L234 268 C230 232 220 185 218 135 C216 64 182 12 120 12 Z" fill="url(#wraithCore)" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="3.5"/>
                    <!-- Inner Skull / Wraith Face -->
                    <path d="M120 36 C78 36 52 72 52 122 C52 162 74 198 120 206 C166 198 188 162 188 122 C188 72 162 36 120 36 Z" fill="#050102" stroke="#991b1b" stroke-width="2"/>
                    <!-- Glowing Blood Eyes -->
                    <polygon points="70,96 108,110 98,132 66,118" fill="#ef4444"/>
                    <circle cx="88" cy="114" r="18" fill="url(#eyeGlow)"/>
                    <circle cx="88" cy="114" r="5" fill="#ffffff"/>
                    <polygon points="170,96 132,110 142,132 174,118" fill="#ef4444"/>
                    <circle cx="152" cy="114" r="18" fill="url(#eyeGlow)"/>
                    <circle cx="152" cy="114" r="5" fill="#ffffff"/>
                    <!-- Hollow Nose Cavity -->
                    <polygon points="120,126 111,146 129,146" fill="#dc2626"/>
                    <!-- Screaming Jagged Mouth -->
                    <path d="M74 162 Q120 142 166 162 Q176 196 120 202 Q64 196 74 162 Z" fill="#450a0a" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2.5"/>
                    <!-- Sharp Fangs -->
                    <polygon points="84,160 91,178 98,160" fill="#f8fafc"/>
                    <polygon points="102,158 109,182 116,158" fill="#f8fafc"/>
                    <polygon points="124,158 131,182 138,158" fill="#f8fafc"/>
                    <polygon points="142,160 149,178 156,160" fill="#f8fafc"/>
                    <polygon points="92,196 99,180 106,198" fill="#f8fafc"/>
                    <polygon points="134,198 141,180 148,196" fill="#f8fafc"/>
                    <!-- Dripping Blood Streaks -->
                    <path d="M88 130 L88 152 M152 130 L152 154 M120 202 L120 228" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
                </svg>
            </div>
            <div id="ghost-scare-caption" class="font-horror-title text-2xl sm:text-4xl font-black tracking-widest text-red-500 uppercase bg-black/90 px-4 py-1.5 rounded-2xl border-2 border-red-600 shadow-2xl -mt-3">
                👻 BEWARE OF GHOSTMC!
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Toast Notification -->
    <div id="toast-container" class="fixed bottom-5 right-5 z-50 flex flex-col gap-2 pointer-events-none"></div>

    <!-- Live 2026 Theme Switcher Bar -->
    <div class="bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-white/10 py-1.5 px-4 text-xs">
        <div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                <span class="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider bg-gradient-to-r from-red-600 via-rose-500 to-orange-500 text-white shadow-sm shadow-red-600/50">
                    💀 Haunted Horror Edition
                </span>
                <button id="trigger-scare-btn" type="button" class="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-red-950/90 hover:bg-red-800 border border-red-500/70 text-red-200 font-bold text-[11px] transition-all flex items-center gap-1" title="Click to trigger Ghost Jumpscare now">
                    <span>👻 Summon Ghost Now</span>
                </button>
                <button id="toggle-scare-sound-btn" type="button" class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-900/90 hover:bg-slate-800 border border-white/15 text-slate-300 font-semibold text-[11px] transition-all" title="Toggle Horror Sound">
                    🔊 Sound: ON
                </button>
            </div>
            <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                <span class="text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-semibold mr-1">Theme:</span>
                <button type="button" data-set-theme="horror" class="theme-switch-btn px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold bg-red-600/30 border border-red-500/80 text-red-200 shadow-sm transition-all">
                    💀 Blood Horror
                </button>
                <button type="button" data-set-theme="phantom" class="theme-switch-btn px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-semibold bg-slate-900/80 border border-white/10 text-slate-300 hover:text-white transition-all">
                    🔮 Phantom Cyber
                </button>
                <button type="button" data-set-theme="nether" class="theme-switch-btn px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-semibold bg-slate-900/80 border border-white/10 text-slate-300 hover:text-white transition-all">
                    🔥 Nether Blaze
                </button>
                <button type="button" data-set-theme="emerald" class="theme-switch-btn px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-semibold bg-slate-900/80 border border-white/10 text-slate-300 hover:text-white transition-all">
                    🧪 Emerald Matrix
                </button>
                <button type="button" data-set-theme="frost" class="theme-switch-btn px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-semibold bg-slate-900/80 border border-white/10 text-slate-300 hover:text-white transition-all">
                    ❄️ Frost Diamond
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Top Navigation -->
    <header class="sticky top-0 z-40 backdrop-blur-2xl bg-slate-950/75 border-b border-white/10 shadow-lg">
        <div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 h-16 flex items-center justify-between">
            <a href="#hero" class="flex items-center gap-3 group">
                <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="GhostMC Logo" class="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg object-cover border border-cyan-400/50 shadow-sm shadow-cyan-500/30 group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform">
                <div>
                    <span class="font-display font-bold text-lg tracking-wider text-white group-hover:text-cyan-400 transition-colors">GHOST<span class="text-cyan-400">MC</span></span>
                    <span class="block text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest text-cyan-300/70 -mt-1">Minecraft SMP</span>
                </div>
            </a>

            <!-- Desktop Nav -->
            <nav class="hidden md:flex items-center gap-5 text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">
                <a href="#hero" class="hover:text-cyan-400 transition-colors">Home</a>
                <a href="#connect" class="hover:text-cyan-400 transition-colors">Server IP</a>
                <a href="#store" class="hover:text-cyan-400 transition-colors">Ranks & Store</a>
                <a href="#discord" class="hover:text-indigo-400 transition-colors">Discord</a>
                <a href="#staff" class="hover:text-cyan-400 transition-colors">Staff</a>
                <a href="#privacy-policy" class="hover:text-cyan-400 transition-colors">Privacy Policy</a>
            </nav>

            <!-- Quick Copy & Cart Button -->
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3">
                <div class="hidden lg:inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <button id="nav-copy-ip-btn" type="button" class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-900/90 hover:bg-slate-800 border border-cyan-500/30 text-xs font-mono text-cyan-300 transition-all" title="Click to copy IP:Port">
                        <span id="nav-status-dot" class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-amber-400 animate-pulse"></span>
                        <span>GhostMC.hostra.fun:63083</span>
                    </button>
                    <span id="nav-player-pill" class="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-300">Checking...</span>
                </div>
                <button id="open-cart-btn" type="button" class="relative inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-500 to-blue-600 hover:from-cyan-400 hover:to-blue-500 text-slate-950 font-semibold text-xs sm:text-sm shadow-lg shadow-cyan-500/20 transition-all">
                    <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M3 3h2l.4 2M7 13h10l4-8H5.4M7 13L5.4 5M7 13l-2.293 2.293c-.63.63-.184 1.707.707 1.707H17m0 0a2 2 0 100 4 2 2 0 000-4zm-8 2a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0z"/>
                    </svg>
                    <span>Store Cart</span>
                    <span id="cart-badge" class="px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] font-bold rounded-full bg-slate-950 text-cyan-300">0</span>
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </header>

    <!-- Main Content -->
    <main class="flex-grow">
        <!-- Hero Banner -->
        <section id="hero" class="relative pt-10 pb-16 md:pt-16 md:pb-24 overflow-hidden">
            <div class="absolute inset-0 -z-10 bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top,_var(--tw-gradient-stops))] from-purple-900/30 via-fuchsia-950/20 to-transparent"></div>
            <div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
                <div class="flex flex-col lg:flex-row items-center gap-10 lg:gap-12">

            },

                accent: 'from-purple-600/35 via-fuchsia-600/20 to-amber-500/20 border-fuchsia-400/60',
                btnClass: 'bg-gradient-to-r from-fuchsia-400 via-purple-400 to-amber-300 hover:opacity-95 text-slate-950',

            }
        ];

        // App State
        let cart = [];
        let activeFilter = 'all';
        let selectedPayment = 'GPay (Google Pay)';

        // Build official UPI URI for given amount and note
        function buildUpiUri(amount, note) {
            const params = [
                `pa=${encodeURIComponent(MERCHANT_UPI)}`,
                `pn=${encodeURIComponent(MERCHANT_NAME)}`,
                `am=${encodeURIComponent(String(amount))}`,
                `cu=INR`,
                `tn=${encodeURIComponent(note)}`
            ];
            return `upi://pay?${params.join('&')}`;
        }

        // Helper: Copy text with fallback
        function copyToClipboard(text, label) {
            const done = () => showToast(`Copied ${label}: ${text}`);
            if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
                navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(done).catch(() => fallbackCopy(text, done));
            } else {
                fallbackCopy(text, done);
            }
        }

        function fallbackCopy(text, callback) {
            const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
            ta.value = text;
            ta.style.position = 'fixed';
            ta.style.opacity = '0';
            document.body.appendChild(ta);
            ta.select();
            try { document.execCommand('copy'); } catch (e) {}
            document.body.removeChild(ta);
            callback();
        }

        function showToast(message) {
            const container = document.getElementById('toast-container');
            const toast = document.createElement('div');
            toast.className = 'px-4 py-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-900/95 border border-cyan-400/50 text-cyan-200 text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold shadow-xl flex items-center gap-2.5 pointer-events-auto transition-all';
            toast.innerHTML = `<span class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400"></span><span>${message}</span>`;
            container.appendChild(toast);
            setTimeout(() => {
                toast.style.opacity = '0';
                setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 250);
            }, 2600);
        }

        // Render Ranks Grid
        function renderRanks() {
            const grid = document.getElementById('ranks-grid');
            const filtered = activeFilter === 'all'
                ? RANKS_DATA
                : RANKS_DATA.filter(r => r.tier === activeFilter);

            grid.innerHTML = filtered.map(rank => {
                const inCart = cart.some(item => item.id === rank.id);
                return `
                <div class="card-hover rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-b ${rank.accent} border-2 p-6 flex flex-col justify-between relative overflow-hidden">
                    <div class="absolute -top-12 -right-12 w-28 h-28 rounded-full bg-white/5 blur-2xl pointer-events-none"></div>
                    <div>
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-4">
                            <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-slate-950/80 border border-white/10 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider ${rank.textAccent}">
                                #${rank.number} • ${rank.badge}
                            </span>
                            <span class="font-display text-2xl font-black text-white bg-slate-950/80 px-3.5 py-1 rounded-xl border border-white/10">
                                ₹${rank.price}
                            </span>
                        </div>

                        <h3 class="font-display text-2xl font-extrabold text-white">${rank.name}</h3>
                        <div class="mt-2 inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-950/70 border border-white/10 text-xs font-semibold ${rank.textAccent}">
                            <span>🎒 Kit Included: <strong>${rank.kit}</strong></span>
                        </div>

                        <ul class="mt-5 space-y-2 text-xs sm:text-sm text-slate-300">
                            ${rank.perks.map(p => `
                                <li class="flex items-center gap-2">
                                    <span class="text-emerald-400 font-bold">✓</span>
                                    <span>${p}</span>
                                </li>
                            `).join('')}
                        </ul>
                    </div>

                    <div class="mt-6 pt-4 border-t border-white/10 space-y-3">
                        <!-- Payment Badges -->
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-300">
                            <span class="text-slate-400 font-mono text-[11px]">UPI: ${MERCHANT_UPI}</span>
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-white text-slate-900 font-extrabold text-[11px] shadow-sm">GPay</span>
                                <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-purple-600 text-white font-extrabold text-[11px] shadow-sm">PhonePe</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <div class="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-950/75 border border-amber-400/25 text-[11px] text-slate-300 leading-snug">
                            📸 <strong class="text-amber-300">Buy Note:</strong> After payment, take a screenshot of the transaction, go to our <a href="https://discord.gg/H4p2TuNCA" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="text-indigo-300 underline font-semibold">Discord Server</a>, create a ticket, and claim your rank.
                        </div>

                        <div class="flex gap-2">
                            <button type="button" data-buy-id="${rank.id}" class="buy-now-btn flex-1 py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm shadow-lg transition-all ${rank.btnClass}">
                                Buy via UPI • ₹${rank.price}
                            </button>
                            <button type="button" data-cart-id="${rank.id}" class="toggle-cart-btn px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-white/20 bg-slate-950/80 hover:bg-slate-900 text-xs font-semibold text-white transition-all">
                                ${inCart ? '✓ In Cart' : '+ Cart'}
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                `;
            }).join('');

            // Attach listeners to newly rendered buttons
            grid.querySelectorAll('.buy-now-btn').forEach(btn => {
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const id = btn.getAttribute('data-buy-id');
                    const rank = RANKS_DATA.find(r => r.id === id);
                    if (rank) {
                        // Select this rank in cart if not already present
                        if (!cart.some(i => i.id === rank.id)) {
                            cart = [rank];
                        }
                        updateCartUI();
                    }
                    openCheckoutModal();
                });
            });

            grid.querySelectorAll('.toggle-cart-btn').forEach(btn => {
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const id = btn.getAttribute('data-cart-id');
                    const rank = RANKS_DATA.find(r => r.id === id);
                    if (!rank) return;
                    const exists = cart.some(i => i.id === rank.id);
                    if (exists) {
                        cart = cart.filter(i => i.id !== rank.id);
                        showToast(`Removed ${rank.name} from cart`);
                    } else {
                        cart.push(rank);
                        showToast(`Added ${rank.name} (₹${rank.price}) to cart`);
                    }
                    updateCartUI();
                });
            });
        }

        function updateCartUI() {
            const badge = document.getElementById('cart-badge');
            badge.textContent = String(cart.length);
            renderRanks();
            renderModalCart();
        }

        function updateUpiPaymentWidgets() {
            const total = cart.reduce((acc, item) => acc + item.price, 0);
            const username = document.getElementById('mc-username').value.trim() || 'Player';
            const rankNames = cart.map(i => i.name).join(', ') || 'GhostMC Rank';
            const note = `${rankNames} (${username})`;
            const upiUri = buildUpiUri(total > 0 ? total : 30, note);

            // Update direct UPI button href
            const payLink = document.getElementById('direct-upi-pay-link');
            payLink.setAttribute('href', upiUri);
            payLink.innerHTML = total > 0
                ? `<span>⚡ Pay ₹${total} via ${selectedPayment.split(' ')[0]}</span>`
                : `<span>⚡ Pay via UPI App</span>`;

            // Render QR Code
            const qrContainer = document.getElementById('upi-qr-container');
            qrContainer.innerHTML = '';
            if (typeof QRCode !== 'undefined') {
                new QRCode(qrContainer, {
                    text: upiUri,
                    width: 120,
                    height: 120,
                    colorDark: '#070b14',
                    colorLight: '#ffffff',
                    correctLevel: QRCode.CorrectLevel.M
                });
            } else {
                qrContainer.innerHTML = `<div class="text-[11px] text-slate-900 font-mono text-center p-2 break-all">${MERCHANT_UPI}<br><strong>₹${total}</strong></div>`;
            }
        }

        function renderModalCart() {
            const listEl = document.getElementById('modal-cart-items');
            const totalEl = document.getElementById('modal-total-price');

            if (cart.length === 0) {
                listEl.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800 text-center text-xs text-slate-400">
                        Your cart is empty. Select a rank from the store to continue!
                    </div>
                `;
                totalEl.textContent = '₹0';
                updateUpiPaymentWidgets();
                return;
            }

            const total = cart.reduce((acc, item) => acc + item.price, 0);
            totalEl.textContent = `₹${total}`;

            listEl.innerHTML = cart.map(item => `
                <div class="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-950 border border-slate-800">
                    <div>
                        <div class="font-bold text-sm text-white">${item.name}</div>
                        <div class="text-xs text-cyan-400">Kit Included: ${item.kit}</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <span class="font-display font-bold text-sm text-emerald-400">₹${item.price}</span>
                        <button type="button" data-remove-id="${item.id}" class="remove-cart-item text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-400 text-xs font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded bg-slate-900">✕</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `).join('');

            listEl.querySelectorAll('.remove-cart-item').forEach(btn => {
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const id = btn.getAttribute('data-remove-id');
                    cart = cart.filter(i => i.id !== id);
                    updateCartUI();
                });
            });

            updateUpiPaymentWidgets();
        }

        function openCheckoutModal() {
            if (cart.length === 0) {
                cart.push(RANKS_DATA[0]);
                updateCartUI();
            } else {
                updateUpiPaymentWidgets();
            }
            document.getElementById('order-receipt-box').classList.add('hidden');
            const modal = document.getElementById('checkout-modal');
            modal.classList.remove('hidden');
            modal.classList.add('flex');
        }

        function closeCheckoutModal() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('checkout-modal');
            modal.classList.add('hidden');
            modal.classList.remove('flex');
        }

        const SERVER_HOST = 'GhostMC.hostra.fun';
        const SERVER_PORT = 63083;
        let statusIntervalId = null;

        async function fetchServerStatus() {
            const indicator = document.getElementById('server-status-indicator');
            const badge = document.getElementById('server-status-badge');
            const motdEl = document.getElementById('server-motd-text');
            const onlineTextEl = document.getElementById('hero-online-text');
            const playersCountEl = document.getElementById('hero-players-count');
            const navDot = document.getElementById('nav-status-dot');
            const navPill = document.getElementById('nav-player-pill');
            const refreshIcon = document.getElementById('refresh-status-icon');

            if (refreshIcon) refreshIcon.classList.add('animate-spin');

            const endpoints = [
                `https://api.mcstatus.io/v2/status/java/${SERVER_HOST}:${SERVER_PORT}`,
                `https://api.mcsrvstat.us/3/${SERVER_HOST}:${SERVER_PORT}`,
                `https://api.mcstatus.io/v2/status/bedrock/${SERVER_HOST}:${SERVER_PORT}`,
                `https://api.mcsrvstat.us/bedrock/3/${SERVER_HOST}:${SERVER_PORT}`
            ];

            let isOnline = false;
            let onlinePlayers = 0;
            let maxPlayers = 0;
            let cleanMotd = '';

            for (const url of endpoints) {
                try {
                    const res = await fetch(url, { cache: 'no-store' });
                    if (!res.ok) continue;
                    const data = await res.json();
                    if (data && data.online === true) {
                        isOnline = true;
                        onlinePlayers = (data.players && typeof data.players.online === 'number') ? data.players.online : 0;
                        maxPlayers = (data.players && typeof data.players.max === 'number') ? data.players.max : 100;
                        if (data.motd) {
                            if (typeof data.motd.clean === 'string') {
                                cleanMotd = data.motd.clean.trim();
                            } else if (Array.isArray(data.motd.clean)) {
                                cleanMotd = data.motd.clean.join(' ').trim();
                            }
                        }
                        break;
                    } else if (data && data.players && typeof data.players.max === 'number' && maxPlayers === 0) {
                        maxPlayers = data.players.max;
                    }
                } catch (err) {
                    // Try next fallback API
                }
            }

            if (refreshIcon) refreshIcon.classList.remove('animate-spin');

            if (isOnline) {
                indicator.className = 'w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-ping shrink-0';
                badge.className = 'px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-400/40';
                badge.textContent = '● ONLINE';
                onlineTextEl.className = 'font-display font-bold text-emerald-400 text-sm sm:text-base mt-0.5';
                onlineTextEl.textContent = 'ONLINE';
                playersCountEl.textContent = `${onlinePlayers} / ${maxPlayers}`;
                motdEl.textContent = cleanMotd || `Connected to ${SERVER_HOST}:${SERVER_PORT} • Ready to join!`;
                if (navDot) navDot.className = 'w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse';
                if (navPill) {
                    navPill.className = 'px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-500/20 text-[10px] text-emerald-300 font-bold';
                    navPill.textContent = `${onlinePlayers} Online`;
                }
            } else {
                indicator.className = 'w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full bg-rose-500 shrink-0';
                badge.className = 'px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 border border-rose-400/40';
                badge.textContent = '○ OFFLINE';
                onlineTextEl.className = 'font-display font-bold text-rose-400 text-sm sm:text-base mt-0.5';
                onlineTextEl.textContent = 'OFFLINE';
                playersCountEl.textContent = `0 / ${maxPlayers || '--'}`;
                motdEl.textContent = `${SERVER_HOST}:${SERVER_PORT} is currently offline or restarting.`;
                if (navDot) navDot.className = 'w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-rose-500';
                if (navPill) {
                    navPill.className = 'px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-rose-500/20 text-[10px] text-rose-300 font-bold';
                    navPill.textContent = 'Offline';
                }
            }
        }


        // Haunted Ghost Jumpscare System (Pops out from Left or Right side periodically)
        let scareTimerId = null;
        let scareSoundEnabled = true;
        let audioCtx = null;
        let isScareRunning = false;

        const SCARE_MESSAGES = [
            '👻 BEWARE OF GHOSTMC!',
            '💀 YOUR SOUL BELONGS TO GHOSTMC!',
            '🩸 THE PHANTOM IS WATCHING YOU...',
            '👻 CLAIM YOUR RANK OR BE HAUNTED!'
        ];

        function playHorrorScreech() {
            if (!scareSoundEnabled) return;
            try {
                const AudioContextClass = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
                if (!AudioContextClass) return;
                if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new AudioContextClass();
                if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();

                const now = audioCtx.currentTime;
                // Dissonant horror chord + descending shriek
                const freqs = [580, 615, 820, 195];
                freqs.forEach((f, idx) => {
                    const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
                    const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
                    osc.type = idx % 2 === 0 ? 'sawtooth' : 'square';
                    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(f, now);
                    osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(idx === 3 ? 65 : f * 0.42, now + 0.85);

                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, now);
                    gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.06, now + 0.04);
                    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0008, now + 0.9);

                    osc.connect(gain);
                    gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
                    osc.start(now);
                    osc.stop(now + 0.92);
                });
            } catch (e) {}
        }

        function triggerGhostScare(forceSide) {
            if (isScareRunning) return;
            // Don't interrupt if user has checkout modal open unless manually triggered
            const checkoutModal = document.getElementById('checkout-modal');
            if (!forceSide && checkoutModal && !checkoutModal.classList.contains('hidden')) return;

            isScareRunning = true;
            const overlay = document.getElementById('ghost-scare-overlay');
            const flash = document.getElementById('ghost-scare-flash');
            const figure = document.getElementById('ghost-scare-figure');
            const caption = document.getElementById('ghost-scare-caption');

            const side = forceSide || (Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'left' : 'right');
            const randomMsg = SCARE_MESSAGES[Math.floor(Math.random() * SCARE_MESSAGES.length)];
            if (caption) caption.textContent = randomMsg;

            overlay.classList.remove('hidden');
            overlay.classList.add('flex');
            overlay.style.justifyContent = side === 'left' ? 'flex-start' : 'flex-end';

            // Vertical position variation (top, middle, or bottom-ish)
            const vPositions = ['items-center', 'items-start pt-16', 'items-end pb-16'];
            const pickedV = vPositions[Math.floor(Math.random() * vPositions.length)];
            overlay.className = `fixed inset-0 flex overflow-hidden ${pickedV}`;

            flash.classList.remove('blood-flash-active');
            figure.classList.remove('ghost-lunge-left', 'ghost-lunge-right');
            document.body.classList.remove('horror-screen-shake');

            // Force reflow
            void overlay.offsetWidth;

            flash.classList.add('blood-flash-active');
            figure.classList.add(side === 'left' ? 'ghost-lunge-left' : 'ghost-lunge-right');
            document.body.classList.add('horror-screen-shake');

            playHorrorScreech();

            setTimeout(() => {
                overlay.classList.add('hidden');
                overlay.classList.remove('flex');
                document.body.classList.remove('horror-screen-shake');
                isScareRunning = false;
            }, 1680);
        }

        function scheduleNextGhostScare() {
            if (scareTimerId) clearTimeout(scareTimerId);
            // Every 12 to 18 seconds a ghost pops from left or right side
            const nextDelay = 12000 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 6000);
            scareTimerId = setTimeout(() => {
                if (document.body.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'horror') {
                    triggerGhostScare();
                }
                scheduleNextGhostScare();
            }, nextDelay);
        }

        // Initialize Event Listeners
        function applyTheme(themeName) {
            document.body.setAttribute('data-theme', themeName);
            try { localStorage.setItem('ghostmc_theme_horror_v1', themeName); } catch (e) {}
            document.querySelectorAll('.theme-switch-btn').forEach(btn => {
                const isSelected = btn.getAttribute('data-set-theme') === themeName;
                btn.className = isSelected
                    ? 'theme-switch-btn px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold bg-white/15 border border-white/50 text-white shadow-sm transition-all'
                    : 'theme-switch-btn px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-semibold bg-slate-900/80 border border-white/10 text-slate-300 hover:text-white transition-all';
            });
        }

        window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            try {
                const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('ghostmc_theme_horror_v1') || 'horror';
                if (savedTheme) applyTheme(savedTheme);
            } catch (e) {}

            document.querySelectorAll('.theme-switch-btn').forEach(btn => {
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const t = btn.getAttribute('data-set-theme');
                    applyTheme(t);
                    showToast(`Switched to ${btn.textContent.trim()} theme!`);
                });
            });

            renderRanks();
            fetchServerStatus();

            // Trigger an initial side-ghost scare shortly after load (2.8s) and then periodically every 12-18s
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (document.body.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'horror') {
                    triggerGhostScare();
                }
            }, 2800);
            scheduleNextGhostScare();

            const summonBtn = document.getElementById('trigger-scare-btn');
            if (summonBtn) {
                summonBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    triggerGhostScare(Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'left' : 'right');
                });
            }

            const soundBtn = document.getElementById('toggle-scare-sound-btn');
            if (soundBtn) {
                soundBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    scareSoundEnabled = !scareSoundEnabled;
                    soundBtn.textContent = scareSoundEnabled ? '🔊 Sound: ON' : '🔇 Sound: OFF';
                    showToast(scareSoundEnabled ? 'Horror Scare Sound Enabled!' : 'Horror Scare Sound Muted');
                });
            }
            if (statusIntervalId) clearInterval(statusIntervalId);
            statusIntervalId = setInterval(fetchServerStatus, 60000);

            document.getElementById('refresh-status-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
                fetchServerStatus();
                showToast('Refreshing GhostMC server status...');
            });

            // Copy triggers
            document.querySelectorAll('.copy-trigger').forEach(btn => {
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    copyToClipboard(btn.getAttribute('data-copy'), btn.getAttribute('data-label'));
                });
            });

            document.getElementById('nav-copy-ip-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
                copyToClipboard('GhostMC.hostra.fun:63083', 'Server IP & Port');
            });

            document.getElementById('hero-copy-all-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
                copyToClipboard('GhostMC.hostra.fun:63083', 'Server IP & Port');
            });

            document.getElementById('modal-copy-upi-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
                copyToClipboard(MERCHANT_UPI, 'UPI ID');
            });

            // Live update QR & UPI note when username changes
            document.getElementById('mc-username').addEventListener('input', () => {
                updateUpiPaymentWidgets();
            });

            // Direct UPI Pay button click feedback
            document.getElementById('direct-upi-pay-link').addEventListener('click', () => {
                const total = cart.reduce((acc, i) => acc + i.price, 0);
                copyToClipboard(MERCHANT_UPI, 'UPI ID');
                showToast(`Opening UPI App for ₹${total} to ${MERCHANT_UPI}...`);
            });

            // Filter buttons
            document.querySelectorAll('.rank-filter-btn').forEach(btn => {
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    activeFilter = btn.getAttribute('data-filter');
                    document.querySelectorAll('.rank-filter-btn').forEach(b => {
                        b.className = 'rank-filter-btn px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-slate-900 text-slate-300 border border-slate-800 hover:border-cyan-500/40 transition-all';
                    });
                    btn.className = 'rank-filter-btn px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-cyan-500 text-slate-950 transition-all';
                    renderRanks();
                });
            });

            // Modal controls
            document.getElementById('open-cart-btn').addEventListener('click', openCheckoutModal);
            document.getElementById('close-modal-btn').addEventListener('click', closeCheckoutModal);
            document.getElementById('checkout-modal').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                if (e.target.id === 'checkout-modal') closeCheckoutModal();
            });

            // Payment method selection
            document.querySelectorAll('.pay-method-btn').forEach(btn => {
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    selectedPayment = btn.getAttribute('data-pay');
                    document.querySelectorAll('.pay-method-btn').forEach(b => {
                        b.className = 'pay-method-btn p-3 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-800 bg-slate-950 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-sm font-bold text-slate-300 transition-all';
                    });
                    btn.className = 'pay-method-btn p-3 rounded-xl border-2 border-cyan-400 bg-cyan-500/10 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-sm font-bold text-white transition-all';
                    updateUpiPaymentWidgets();
                });
            });

            // Clear Cart
            document.getElementById('clear-cart-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
                cart = [];
                updateCartUI();
                document.getElementById('order-receipt-box').classList.add('hidden');
                showToast('Cart cleared');
            });

            // Generate Order Ticket
            document.getElementById('generate-order-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
                if (cart.length === 0) {
                    showToast('Please add at least one rank first!');
                    return;
                }
                const username = document.getElementById('mc-username').value.trim() || 'Player';
                const edition = document.getElementById('mc-edition').value;
                const utr = document.getElementById('upi-utr').value.trim() || 'Pending / Screenshot Attached';
                const total = cart.reduce((acc, i) => acc + i.price, 0);
                const ranksList = cart.map(i => `${i.name} (${i.kit}) - ₹${i.price}`).join(', ');

                const receipt = [
                    `👑 GHOSTMC SMP STORE ORDER`,
                    `Player IGN: ${username} (${edition})`,
                    `Selected Ranks: ${ranksList}`,
                    `Total Paid: ₹${total}`,
                    `Paid To UPI ID: ${MERCHANT_UPI} (${selectedPayment})`,
                    `UTR / Ref No.: ${utr}`,
                    `Server: GhostMC.hostra.fun:63083`,
                    `Discord: https://discord.gg/H4p2TuNCA`,
                    `Claim Step: Take payment screenshot -> Go to Discord -> Create Ticket -> Claim Rank!`,
                    `Verify With: Owner Devesh / 2nd Owner Total`
                ].join('\n');

                const box = document.getElementById('order-receipt-box');
                const pre = document.getElementById('order-receipt-text');
                pre.textContent = receipt;
                box.classList.remove('hidden');
                copyToClipboard(receipt, 'Order Ticket');
            });
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
